newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market up, oil refiners in demand.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market up, oil refiners in demand.

text.p: Rising prices for oil refiners and cement makers led Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market higher on Monday, traders said.
They said the bullish mood would pervade the entire week, with foreign investors focusing on blue chips.
"Refineries will stay in high demand this week, with foreigners eager to take up whatever is available," one trader said. "They still have enough money to maintain buying presure on high caps."
Some traders said many local and foreign investors had started looking at small cap listings with future potential.
"Many heavy weights will soon become too expensive and our clients want listings which might have less liquidity now but could have high potential in the near future," another said.
On Monday, gainers outnumbered decliners 191 to 73, with 305 stocks remaining flat.
Three independent indices computed by securities companies based on average prices and market capitalisation gained ground from the previous session.
The VAB-RA all-share index was up 2.9 percent to 6,221.7 points, BIG-OTC rose by 3.07 percent to 4,904.74 and CAS-RQ grew 2.86 percent to 1,103 points.

Petromidia oil refinery closed 5,500 lei higher at 46,000 under strong buying preesure, while Petrobrazi refinery firmed 1,800 lei to 54,800. Arpechim, a third refinery, closed flat at 53,000 lei from its Friday's close.
Cement maker Romcim went up 5,000 lei to 130,000. A second cement maker, Moldocim ended 1,500 lei higher at 54,500.

Steel mill Sidex inched down 500 lei to 23,500 in late trading. Traders said trading would ease on Tuesday, leaving Sidex at about the same level, but buying pressure would push it up later in the week.
Turnover on Monday fell to 38.01 billion lei from 40.2 billion previously.
